title: Baba Mere Baba
body:

Is shaam key zindaan mein dum ghut'taa hai mera

Rudaad sunani hai mujhey Karbobala ki...

Baba Mere Baba
<<DIVIDER>>
Sar kat tey hi bus aapka tooti jo qayamat
Aafat pa thee aafat
QaimoN ko jalaney key k liye aagaye aa'daa
<<MINI>>
Baba Mere Baba
<<DIVIDER>>
Manzar bhi ajab shaam-e-gharibaaN nazar aaye
Hum dekh na Paaye
Paamaal huva saamney phir aapka iaashaa
<<MINI>>
Baba Mere Baba
<<DIVIDER>>
KaanoN sey merey cheen liye Shimr ney gouhar
KhooN behta tha aksar
Kistarha kahooN kysa mila aapka pursa
<<MINI>>
Baba Mere Baba
<<DIVIDER>>
Roney pa bhi pabandi łagaye thei sitamgaar
Rona bhi tha dushwaar
Jee bhar key nahiN ro sakey hum aapko Baba
<<MINI>>
Baba Mere Baba
<<DIVIDER>>
Aansoo meri aankhoN sey tapaktey thei sarasar
so paana tha dubhar Aur yaad thee har gaam pa bus aapki Baba
<<MINI>>
Baba Mere Baba
<<DIVIDER>>
Bey yaaro madadgaar samajhkar yeh zamana
deyta raha taana
Har modd pa sadqa liye aajaatey thei aa'daa
<<MINI>>
Baba Mere Baba
<<DIVIDER>>
Umeed nahin hai key watan jaaye Sakina
Yaad aati hai Sughra
Mein dekh na paaoungi kabhi behna ka chehra
<<MINI>>
Baba Mere Baba

Hasrat hai mujhey Baba miley aapka seena
So jaaye Sakina
Aye Moosvi kehti rahi bus baaii Sakina
